Summarize a fitted wisp model

summary.wisp.Rd

Builds an object of class "summary.wisp", primarily wrapping the parameter table computed by sample_stats (x$stats$parameters), plus the same model-size/fit-setting context shown by print.wisp. Use print.summary.wisp (dispatched automatically by print()) to display the result.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'wisp'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

List, output of the wisp function (an object of class "wisp").

...

Ignored; present only for S3 method consistency with summary.

Value

An object of class "summary.wisp": a list with elements parameters (the parameter table from object$stats$parameters, or NULL if statistical analysis was never run – e.g. the model was fit with fit_only = TRUE), n.context, n.species, n.ran, sample.params.type, n.bs, and n.mcmc.

Examples

set.seed(1)
grid <- expand.grid(bin = 1:20, age = c(12, 18), ran = c("r1", "r2"), rep = 1:6)
base_rate <- ifelse(grid$bin <= 10, 3, 9)
age_effect <- ifelse(grid$age == 18, 1.5, 1)
grid$count <- rpois(nrow(grid), base_rate * age_effect)
countdata <- data.frame(
  bin = grid$bin, count = grid$count, age = grid$age, ran = grid$ran,
  species = "demoGene", context = "demoContext"
)
model <- wisp(
  countdata,
  variables      = list(timeseries = "age"),
  model.settings = list(LRO_cost = "none"),
  plot.settings  = list(print.plots = FALSE),
  MCMC.settings  = list(MCMC.steps = 100, MCMC.burnin = 20),
  bootstraps.num = 10,
  max.fork       = 1,
  verbose        = FALSE
)
summary(model)
